issue_title: Devil's Reign - Chapter Four: When The Ball Drops
description:
[Continued from GHOST RIDER/BALLISTIC #1.]

At the behest of Zoe Culloden, Wolverine went to the offices of Landau, Luckman & Lake to cross over to the Top Cow Universe to assist in defeating Mephisto. He proceeds through crowds of decadent New Year's Eve revelers, to get to this dimension's LL&L offices in an effort to locate Zoe. There, he finds a man rifling through a file cabinet. Logan questions him, learning only that Zoe was taken by the "Mayor's goons".

Wolverine makes his way to Times Square and gets into a scuffle with a team of armored thugs beating on a person who isn't exhibiting enough depravity for the Mayor's taste. Wolverine falls to a neural stunner, but moments later, the goons are shot dead. Logan recovers and looks up to see Ballistic holding a smoking weapon. The two retreat to a warehouse to compare notes. Ballistic tells him she's searching for her missing ally Heatwave, who is being mind-controlled, and that whatever is happening in Times Square must be stopped before midnight, or Mephisto will claim the souls of all the celebrants.

Soon, the pair ride a zip line to the former church where they suspect the "Mayor" to be. Inside, they find the Mayor is actually the mind-controlled Heatwave and in his company is Zoe, also brainwashed. A battle erupts, and after the armored thugs have been subdued, Wolverine takes on Heatwave while Ballistic tackles Zoe. Zoe snaps out of her trance and shoots Heatwave with her stun gun.

Then the trio hear bells chiming midnight. Rushing to a view of Times Square, they find it devoid of life.

Elsewhere, Mephisto sets his sights on Sara Pezzini.

[To be continued in WOLVERINE/WITCHBLADE #1.]

issue_title: The Sherlock Holmes of Modern Times
description:
Ghastly beheadings, bloody murders, and cold-hearted child abductions--

Precocious high school student Jimmy Kudo uses his keen powers of observation and astute intuition to solve mysteries that have left law enforcement officials baffled. Hot on the trail of a suspect, Jimmy is accosted from behind and fed a strange chemical which physically transforms him into a grade schooler! Taking on the pseudonym Conan Edogawa, he attempts to track down the people who did this to him. But until he finds a cure for his bizarre condition, Jimmy continues to help the police solve their toughest cases.

Can you crack the case before Conan does?

And, as if that wasn't bad enough, Conan and his pals get swept up in a missing person caper at the local library. Murder, kidnapping and drug smuggling aren't exactly the sorts of things condoned by librarians. What's the connection? Conan thinks he knows the answer but he's got more pressing things to worry about--like escaping the deadly grasp of the fiendish miscreant!

A Sporting Chance, Chip 'n' Dale hide an acorn in trick golf ball to elude a weasel.

Two for Trouble, Chip 'n' Dale start a baby-sitting service.

The Defective Detective, Chip 'n' Dale solve "missing eggs" case with help of a kangaroo rat.

High Neighbors, Chip 'n' Dale move to an "apartment tree" in the city.

Tree for Three, Donald Duck is a tree surgeon; Chip 'n' Dale pretend that an old oak tree is ill.

Beach Buddies, Chip 'n' Dale and Busby Bee contend over a spot at a crowded beach.

Seashore Shenanigans, Chip 'n' Dale and a pelican have adventures on the sea shore.

Something to Crow About, A pair of crows throw Chip 'n' Dale out of their home and move in themselves.

Fish 'n' Chips, Chip 'n' Dale accidentally stow away on Donald's boat and rescue him from a swordfish.

Trance Troubles, Chip 'n' Dale read a book on hypnotism and try to hypnotize Brer Bear into thinking he's a chipmunk.

The Broom Boom, Practical has inherited a broom factory; A witch hypnotizes the lazy brothers into providing brooms for witches.

Chump Munks, Chip 'n' Dale misinterpret an insulting post card from Donald Duck as a gift ("Nuts to You!") and the forest animals are out of food when winter hits; Brer Fox and Brer Bear have gathered all the food , but get knocked out when trying to catch Chip.

Auto Antics, Chip 'n' Dale find a toy car.

Personality Perfection, Practical Pig's "personality switcher" machine brings out the industrious side of the lazy brothers.

The Moose-Music Makers, Chip wants to make music, but when he uses an old moose call for a horn there is no peace in the forest.

House Haunters, After lightning strikes their tree, Chip 'n' Dale take refuge from a storm in an old deserted house; But Brer Fox and Brer Bear have the same idea.

Buddy Battle, Chip 'n' Dale try to outdo each other to impress a lady chipmunk named "Chi-Chi."

The Map Mishap, Chip 'n' Dale draw a map with directions to the homes in the forest; but the Big Bad Wolf finds it and kidnaps most of the residents.

The Duffer Duck, Chip 'n' Dale harass Donald during a round of golf.

Snowbound, Donald is playing with a model train (one big enough for him to ride on it) and Chip 'n' Dale get even with him for a snow shoveling trick he played on them earlier.

The Magic Spell, Old Witch" gives Chip 'n' Dale flying power so they can steal jewels.

Southern Exposure, Tired of the cold weather, Chip 'n' Dale try to find a way to fly south.

Good Scouts, Donald is a scoutmaster at a camp and Chip 'n' Dale want to join the scouts.

The Defective Detective, Dale wants to be a detective.

The Large Charge, Chip 'n' Dale use a battery to set a booby-trap for a marten.

On the Move, Chip 'n' Dale are living in a tree in a nursery, and the buyer of the tree's son wants the two to be included in the price.

Model Muddle, Morty and Ferdie bring their model rocket to the woods to fire it off.

Get Rich Witch, The Witch puts a magic potion into the pond that turns any animal that touches the water into gold.
The Diamond Hunt, Chip 'n' Dale find an old shoe, which contains a diamond stolen by Brer Fox and Brer Weasel.

Peace and Quiet, Donald comes to Chip 'n' Dale's woods to practice for hunting season which begins the next day; Chip 'n' Dale use catsup to write "No Hunting " on the trees, which turns the place into an impromptu animal sanctuary.

Quick on the Claw, Chip 'n' Dale move to the desert to escape the winter and meet Guy Ground Squirrel.

The Snow Pirate, A mouse on a rigged sled intends to be a pirate, but is foiled by Chip 'n' Dale.

The Mysterious Cloud, Chip 'n' Dale and Dumbo mistake a disguised blimp for a rain cloud.

Rapid Rabbit Rescue, Chip 'n' Dale keep Brer Fox from eating a family of bunnies, with help from a snow blower driven by Brer Bear.
Variant: Whitman Logo cover (see pic 2)

Sudden Danger, Chip 'n' Dale return to the desert to help their friend Gary Ground Squirrel get rid of a snapping turtle.

Shelter Shortage, The King of the Planet Piffle sends a tree shaped rocket to Earth to gather his favorite food—acorns; Chip 'n' Dale get caught in the harvest and eat the acorns on the way back to Piffle.

TV Jeebies, Chip 'n' Dale want to watch the westerns on Donald's TV. Donald wants to watch the "Loretta Duck" show.

Invention for Trouble, Chip 'n' Dale ask Gyro to invent easier way of getting nuts up to the tree. He comes up with an "Acorn Magnet."

Freeway Fracas, Black Pete is operating a steam shovel which is clearing a path through the forest for a freeway.

Counterfeit Hot Cakes, Chip 'n' Dale foil some counterfeiters by making a pile of hot cakes in the money press.

Fish Fiasco, Chip 'n' Dale are friends with Billy Bass the fish; Brer Fox and Brer Bear try to catch the fish to sell to an aquarium.

The Fright Flight, Chip 'n' Dale teach a baby flying squirrel how to fly.

Forest Vigilantes, Deer hunter Black Pete tries to cook dinner on a campfire, but Chip 'n' Dale ruin his meal and eventually force him from the forest with the help of some beavers.

Flying High, Chip 'n' Dale are printing their own newspaper "The Forest News"; During a flood they print a special edition and send it via "air mail" to a group of beavers who patch a hole in the dam.

The Stander-Uppers, Chip 'n' Dale mail themselves to Uncle Charlie. Mickey Mouse is a mail carrier.

issue_title: To Bee or Not to Bee

description:
Night Fright, Chip 'n' Dale seek refuge from a thunderstorm in a cave and find a missing chipmunk child.

The Troublesome Twosome, Donald is painting landscapes in the woods; Chip 'n' Dale are trying to learn to fly and ruin his painting.
The chipmunks help the Three Little Pigs elude the Big Bad Wolf; a talent scout is really a hungry fox in sunglasses and an Ed Norton hat; Chi Chi the girl chipmunk discovers feminism.

Service with a Smile, Donald has trouble with Chip 'n' Dale while he is running a service station.

Spooks A-Poppin', Chip 'n' Dale take refuge from a storm in an old house as do Brer Bear and Brer Fox. Exploding popcorn is mistaken for ghosts.

Business Buddies, Donald robs Chip 'n' Dale's tree of walnuts to make nut butter.

Acorn Airlift, Brer Bear and Brer Fox try to steal chickens from a pen but are foiled by a mean rooster.

Code Capers starring Three Little Pigs, The lazy brothers are too busy playing with a telegraph set to do their chores.

Cheerer Uppers, Chip 'n' Dale befriend a caterpillar with sore feet.

Beaver Bedlam, Chip 'n' Dale get caught in Brer Bear's beaver trap.

The Moose Mix-up, Chip 'n' Dale make stilts to help make Morris tall enough to eat leaves off trees.

Uprooted, Donald transplants Chip 'n' Dale's tree from the forest to his yard.

Buried Treasure, Chip 'n' Dale think they've found a treasure in a hole full of nuts, not knowing they belong to a ground squirrel.

The Madcap Movie, Chip 'n' Dale sneak into a drive-in theater; Donald is guard and causes chaos when he tries to kick them out.

Way Out West, Chip 'n' Dale return to the desert to help the ground squirrels they met in an earlier story (Chip 'n' Dale #24) outwit a porcupine.

Two in a Tizzy, Donald's speedboat swamps Chip 'n' Dale's homemade sailboat.

All Shook Up, Donald uses a nut-shaker attachment on a tractor to shake the nuts off the trees.

Tree Doctor, Donald is patching holes in trees for the Tree Conservation Service and wants to seal up the hole in Chip 'n' Dale's tree.

Easy Does It, A witch loses a magic wand and Dale finds it.

House Haunters, After lightning strikes their tree, Chip 'n' Dale take refuge from a storm in an old deserted house. But Brer Fox and Brer Bear have the same idea.

Chip 'n' Dale Meet Little Peeper, Chip 'n' Dale rescue a lost chick from a chicken hawk.

Chipmunk Champions, Chip gets hit by a bolt of lightning, which temporarily electrifies him. He shocks Pluto, but the charge wears off and Pluto chases the pair.

Lion Around, Chip 'n' Dale get tired of Brer Rabbit's tall tales, but when he tells them there's a lion in the forest, he's telling the truth.

Li'l Log Cabin Home, A beaver chews down Chip 'n' Dale's tree, but the pair get a log cabin as a replacement.

Service with a Smile, Donald has trouble with Chip 'n' Dale while he is running a service station.

Big City Bedlam, Chip 'n' Dale go to the city, but find it a dangerous place.

Notes

  • Features the Hostess Twinkies Cakes ad, Spider-Man Meets June Jitsui!

The Doodleberry Dilemma, Chip 'n' Dale put a twist on the Little Red Riding Hood story; Pretending that a snow figure in bed is Brer Fox, they trick Brer Bear out of a doodleberry pie.

Flying High, Chip 'n' Dale wish they could fly and get their wish granted via a model plane and a kite.

Palsy-Walsy, Chip 'n' Dale and Donald Duck have a free-for-all in the middle of winter.

The Cow-Nappers, A pair of thieves steal Grandma Duck's prize milk cow, but are foiled by Chip 'n' Dale.
Includes a Hostess Fruit Pie ad titled "Casper and The Boo Keepers."

Habitat Trouble, Seeking peace and quiet, Chip 'n' Dale try to live like beavers.

description:
UK reprint containing two partial US issues:

1) Silver Surfer #4: The Good, the Bad, and the Uncanny!

2) The X-Men #4: The Brotherhood of Evil Mutants
Turok tells his story.

How Turok came to be separated from his friend Andar and end up in a new time and new world with a technological-enhanced dinosaur named Mon-Ark in pursuit.

This issue is a recap to catch the reader up to this new Lost Land. Turok and Andar find the lost land and befriend a new tribe only to have them killed by Bionisaurs led by Mothergod. Despite being aided by the likes of Magnus, X-O Manowar and many other super-humans. This event puts Turok on a mission of revenge against Mon-Ark and his mate that killed his tribe. The planned revenge fails when Turok and Mon-Ark are transported to a new time leaving Andar forever.

In this new new time Turok finds a new tribe but Mon-Ark comes soon to wipe them out in the same way they did in the old land of the Lost. Quick to stop them Turok wins a victory against an army of Bionisaurs but does not stop Mon-Ark. The beasts came to the tribe to find Turok in fear the tribes tells turok to go in hope that the beasts will not return with him gone. Turok finds himself were he started on the first page of the book. He is alone in a new world with a powerful enemy that he seeks revenge against.

Covers

  • Regular edition,
  • Variant edition: Gold Logo
  • VVSS edition: Valiant Validated Signature Series comic book

First Appearance

This issue is the first appearance of the Bionasaur Mon-Ark. Mon-Ark quickly become an arch enemy of Turok as he is seemingly the cause of Andar's death. It is also the first appearance of Carlos Comacho a Drug Lord in South America who whose men are being killed and eaten by Mon Ark's dinosaurs.

Turok goes away to a remote area of Utah to think about life and recover from things that occurred in his last adventure and while there has to deal with an evil merchandiser who has a dinosaur.

Turok is mediating in Utah when Bile joins and convinces him to comeback with him to him animal preserve. When they get there they see everyone and everything has been killed including Monty the White buffalo. Everyone was killed by Chun Lee Fat's people for the Monty's horns. The horns were ground down to be used as an aphrodisiac.

This act puts Turok and Bile on the warpath, and they take out several of Fat's men and capture one as a prisoner whom will be tortured for information on Fat's Whereabouts. Fat meanwhile sells the ground horn and goes back to his lair in Los Angeles (L.A.). In L.A. he he takes a rival and throws him into a room with hie "Dragon". His dragon actually being a dinosaur with cybernetic enhancements from Mothergod.

Realizing that Chun Lee Fat has one of the technologically-enhanced dinosaurs, Turok travels to California to stop his evil plans but walks into a trap.

Prologue: Two men plan on robbing the rich Chun Lee Fat only to fall prey to his "dragon" the dragon is none other than cyberneticaly enhanced dinosaur who kills and eats the two bungling burglars.

Story: In Utah, Turok tortures a man to death to find out about Chun Lee Fat. Once he knows his general plan he sets out toward Los Angeles to stop him. On his journey he runs into baddies from two different gangs and sets himself up as a rival animal parts dealer to flush him out. Once he finds Fat's lair he sets on a path that leads him right into the clutches of Fat's "dragon"

Turok has to battle both man and monsters in order to stop Chun Lee Fat's evil reign.

Turok is in a pit with a cyberneticly enhanced dinosaur in Chun Lee Fat's pit. It is the final confrontation with the beast. After that battle Turok fights his way past the Golden Dragons, Fang and Chun Lee himself. Once all seems one Turok finds out he has only defeated one of a pair of dinosaurs and must fight the last one in the final confrontation of the story.

Captain Red, part man and part machine, tells how he came to be what he is today and how his group of followers joined him and how they started a search for a treasure, which leads them to Turok.

Captain Red was a pirate Captain in 1752 and was burring some treasure when he was was transported to the land of the lost. It was here that he met Mothergod who had him subjected to many medical procedures that replaced his body parts with cybernetic implants. The surgical procedures were painful and done without anesthetic.

It was during his captivity that Mothergod was over thrown and he made his escape finding two dinosaur cyborgs were were subjected to the same kind of procedures and a robot named OU82. All of them swore the allegiance to Captain Red and in a way became his new crew.

On their way out of Mothergod's den they were once again transported this time to the "modern era" where they stayed underground trying to learn about the new world until they decide to find Captain Red's old treasure.

Turok is undergoing a test a university when a reporter is pops up and tries to take some photos only to be stopped by Turok and run away. The reporter however in his made dash falls into a manhole and ends up right in the lad of Captain Red and his crew.

First Appearance

  • Captain Red (Esau Vestment)
  • Proto
  • Misfire
  • Robot OU-8-2

A pirate captain from the past, now part man and part machine, and now in the present time, is searching for his treasure, and nobody better stand in his or his followers' way, including Turok and company.

Captain Red has set out with his crew to find his treasure from a few hundred years ago. Unfortunately and ironically he sets out on his adventure at the exact college that Turok and his friends are visiting. Captain Red and crew go to the college library to get new maps of the location and in the turmoil take a young woman the Andy Howell had an affinity for. Andy charges Red and is quickly knocked back but, as soon as he is rebuffed Turok steps up and battles Red. Just as it looks like Turok has the upper hand Misfire knocks Turok down. This is too much for Andy who again goes back to get Red and is slashed across the chest for his effort.

The battle over and Red having what he came for leaves. Turok cradles a badly wounded Andy and calls for help. Before Red can get too far Turok runs after him swearing that he will pay.

description: Turok is asked to help when covert operatives are being killed by the technological enhanced dinosaurs and during the hunt, Turok discovers that the dinosaurs are acting differently.

description: When Turok discovers that the technological enhanced dinosaurs who are killing covert operatives are acting differently, he suspects that someone is controlling and altering them and seeks to find out who.

issue_title: Jurassic Politics - Part Three: The Price Of Vengeance
description: Turok is captured by the leader controlling the technological enhanced dinosaurs and discovers that he is in league with the Spider Demons.

While continuing his battle with the technological-enhanced dinosaurs, Turok forms an uneasy alliance with a South American drug lord and obtains superior weapons.

Alone again Turok roams a South American jungle hunting Mon-Ark's dinosaurs. His time here has brought him the attention of Carlos Comacho. Carlos is a Drug Lord whose business is going down quickly thanks to the dinosaurs that are killing and eating his men. Hearing about Turok he seeks him out and supplies him with his best weapons to kill the beasts. Turok uneasy of Carlos offer accepts.

Turok also runs into a woman named Maria Cortez who wants Turok to capture these dinosaurs alive to breed them for science. Turok refuses and eventually in a climatic conclusion Turok fights and kills the mate of Mon-Ark with Carols weapons only to find out from Maria that despite his help the mate of Mon-Ark has already laid a brood of eggs and they are going to reproduce without Turok's help.
When some old enemies of Turok bust out of prison, Turok and company try to help locate and recapture them.
Turok and company have to join with some questionable allies in the quest to capture some old enemies who have escaped from prison.
Turok and company are captured by the enemies that he has been hunting but Andy escapes and tries to find help.
While in captivity, Turok is forced to engage in battle and then finds himself caught between old enemies, bounty hunters and the law and he then makes a decision that will change his life.

Turok and company have entered the timestream and where will it take them? To a tribe in the far past that was once enslaved by the Mothergod and now needs help.

Original cover color-art by Bill Dunn - see pic below.

1st appearance:

- Campaigner

- Seer (Merlin)
Turok and company have returned to the lost land and find that much has changed and that a foe called the Campaigner is trying to fulfill the Mothergod's plans.
Now back in the Lost Land which is threatened by an evil force commanded by the Campaigner, Turok and company are surprised to find an ally in their battle – their old enemy Captain Red.
Wanting revenge for the destruction of his people and their village, Captain Red decides to take the fight for the Lost Land right straight to the Campaigner and Turok and company go with him.
Now back in the present time, Turok is asked to hunt down a tyrannosaurus rex that is terrorizing an area in Bolivia and of course, things don't go as planned.

Turok discovers some symbols of the Primitives, a prehistoric tribe from the Lost Land, at crime scenes occurring in Dallas, Texas and decides to investigate.

1st appearance:

- Kru

Turok joins a group that is heading to Mon-Ark's lair with intent to destroy the tribe of technological-enhanced dinosaurs and during the fight Turok engages in a final battle with Mon-Ark.

Turok teams up with Carlos Comacho and Maria Cortz to wipe out the dinosaurs that have been killing so many people in the jungle of Columbia. Turok also sees an old flame Serita who gives him a gift of one last electronic arrow that will help him in his fight against Mon-Ark.
The killer that Turok is hunting in Dallas, Texas turns out not to be a raptor but an ally who Turok must now hunt down.

Turok and Regan join a research and documentary film crew's expedition to the Lost Land, but the documentary crew turns out to be an action film production, which leads to trouble and danger.

1st appearance:

- Readiomen

issue_title: Radio Men Of Lost Land! - Part 2
description: Turok and company have to journey to the lair in the Lost Land where the kidnapped members of the expedition are held hostage and do a rescue mission.

issue_title: Radio Men Of Lost Land! - Part 3: Bride Of The Radio Men!
description: This issue features a tale of Turok's past in the Lost Land in which he and Andar help a lost member of the Children of the Moon tribe.
This issue features a tale of Turok's past in the Lost Land in which he and Andar help a lost member of the Children of the Moon tribe.
A tale from Turok's past in the Lost Land continues as he and Andar have to protect the lost member of the Children of the Moon tribe from the Beast Men which wants her for a sacrifice.

issue_title: Tree Of Life, Land Of Shadows
description: Turok is meeting his old enemies and his old friends. The only problem is that he can't figure out how and why these meetings are happening.
While exploring the Lost Land, Turok and company discover a mysterious temple which leads them to a lost Nazi civilization occupied by Nazi women.

issue_title: Island Of Nazi Women - Part 2:The Resurrection
description: While held hostage, Turok and company find out how the lost Nazi civilization got started and then have to find a way to stop their plans to resurrect Adolph Hitler.
After an aerial battle with Longhunter, Turok and company crash land in a remote part of the Lost Land and when pursued on the ground by Longhunter, they run into some unexpected company.

issue_title: Shades Of Yesterday Part 1: The Valley Of The Shadow
description:
When a government agent arrives to make sure that Turok isn't being exploited in the present time, he learns what happened to his friend Andar.

Turok is ten about five years later in time than form the last issue. What has happened since then is not explained. He discovers his old friend was not killed by Mon-Ark like he thought but Andar was simply transported to an earlier time than Turok.

Turok is also introduced to Andy and Reagan Howell. The three of them will become a new team as they go fourth on a new adventure and as Turok swore to his Brother in Spirit Andar that he would teach Andar the "old ways". Everything ends whenthe FBI come calling to get Turok to "hunt" again.

First Appearances

  • Andy (Grandson of Andar)
  • Reagan Howell (Granddaughter of Andar)
  • Longhunter (Israel Crocket)

issue_title: Outlaws Of Lost Land - Part II: Shawnee Silver
description: Captured by some Confederate soldiers, Turok and company have no choice in helping them locate a lost cache of sacred silver guarded by a long line of "secret keepers".

When Andy becomes involved with the Church of the Free Mind, a cult whose leader has been accused of murder, Turok is reminded of a past, similar incident in the Lost Land with Andar and resolves to try to do something about this cult.
After infiltrating the cult Church of the Free Mind, Turok is captured and Vane, the leader of the cult, tries to convert Turok to their ways.
While on a case with Andy in the present time, Turok flashbacks and recalls his younger days in his tribe when he sought to win the hand in marriage of Ravenwing, the chief's daughter.
Turok continues to flashback to the time when he sought to win the hand in marriage of Ravenwing, the chief's daughter, by bringing back a great offering.
While in the Lost Land to teach Andy hunting and survival tactics, Turok comes across some old friends and old enemies.

issue_title: Bred Up In Darkness - Part 2: Blood Of The Son

description:
After the battle with the Lizard People in the Lost Land, Andy runs off on his own and Turok follows to find out what is going on.

Note: Issue also has "Resurrection Rise 2," a four-page preview to the video game.

Final issue.

issue_title: Shades Of Yesterday Pt. 2: Fear No Evil
description:
The F.B.I. has Turok investigate a death that they think was caused by a dinosaur, but they want the dinosaur captured, not killed.

Turok waits by his old friend Andar deathbed and promises to teach Andy Howell the "old ways". After Andar's death Turok, Regan and Andy Howell go on a mission for the Federal Bureau of Investigation (F.B.I.) to track down a family of Alasaurus'. The F.B.I. wants them alive but Turok has his own plans,

Simultaneously, Longhunter has been hired by Mr. Noel to capture the most elusive of prey Turok himself. Turok ends up at odd between everyone including Regan and Andy and the three end up stuck between Longhunter and three very hungry dinosaurs.

Turok is captured and brought to the lair of Dr. Noel, a collector of rare life forms.

Picking up from last issue Turok, Andy Howell and Regan Howell have been already captured by Longhunter. Longhunter then delivers them to Dr. Noel but not before Turok makes his mark on Longhunters face. Dr. Noel plans on keeping Turok as he is a collector of rare species and Turok is a man out of time. Noel considers his a one of a kind specimen.

Before being lock up Turok and the others find out that Dr. Noel has Allosaurus' in his menagerie and they are sick. In their cells the three escape thank to the skills of Andy. the escape is closely monitored by Longhunter and leads to the confrontation on the cover. after the battle Turok goes back in to deal with Dr. Noel. Dr. Noel in fear backs up falling to his death in the allosaurus pet and ominously leaving his psychotic son with the menagerie.

issue_title: New River Part 1: People Of The Spider
description:
Turok and company investigate an attack on a family and the disappearance of a little girl in a wilderness area and the investigation leads to an old enemy of Turok's.

Some dinosaurs are running amok in Gauley Bridge, West Virginia. There is also a tribe (Clan of the Spider People) who kidnap a little girl. With this news the government sends in Turok (and company) and the expert paleontologist, Darwin Challenger. Once in Gauley Bridge they soon find themselves between being dinosaur food and the hostile Spider People.

First Appearances

  • Chichak
  • Spider People (Clan of the Spider)
  • Darwin Challenger
  • Jimmy Nichols
  • Shawn Whiteside

Turok and company fight to save Regan and others from the Spider People and hungry and dangerous dinosaurs.

A little girl has been kidnapped by an ancient tribe known as the Clan of the Spider People led by Chichak Spine-Breaker. Turok has been brought in due to the appearance of dinosaurs in the area. As Turok and company set out to find the Spider People they are watched by the very ones they seek. Quickly Regan Howell and paleontologist Darwin Challenger are captured.

Once captured by Chichak he uses the Regan to taunt Turok and tries to kill Turok by using Darwin as bait for some hungry dinosaurs. Instead Chichaks plans are foiled by Turok when he kills the dinosaurs (with the help of Andy Howell and another dinosaur). His plans foiled Chichak escapes with the little girl and Regan. Turok sets out to find Chichak but he is badly injured by the dinosaur that died and fell on his leg in the previous battle.

All of this puts Chichak's leadership in question and it gets worse when the tribe sees a large dinosaur beast in the moonlight. Up to this point they believed they were in heaven but start to question it after the recent circumstances. Chichak tells them that their must be a sacrifice to make the heaven continue and offers up one of his own people whom has deemed unworthy.

Turok saves Wormfeeder from a sacrifice feeding and then uses his help to rescue Regan and the kidnapped child from the tribe of Spider People.

Turok and Andy Howell find Wormfeeder who is going to be used as a sacrifice. Turok plans on letting him get eaten but Andy's conscience won't let it happen. He shoots at the dinosaur and with the help of Darwin Challenger they all manage to get away.

Now with Wormfeeder in "custody" Turok uses him to get information on the missing girls. Wormfeeder doesn't need much convincing and spills the beans. Turok then tracks down the tribe and has a final confrontation that gets uninterrupted by a redneck posse who kills many of the tribe and put the whole group in custody. The posse is led by the Governor of west Virgina who brings along a news crew and quickly announces that the area will become the only dinosaur hunting preserve.

Hardworking Hayate has a plan to pay back the yakuza--who are now the legal owners of his body parts: he'll kidnap someone and ransom them for a mountain of money! But things get tricky when his would-be kidnappee--who as luck would have it is the daughter of a mind-bogglingly wealthy family--mistakes Hayate's actions for a confession of love, and subsequently hires him to be her personal servant. At least his employment future is secure, or so he thinks...

Final exams are close at hand and Hayate can no longer afford to ignore his studies, but if he's hitting the books, who will keep the Sanzenin mansion spick and span? Anticipating just such an occasion, head butler Klaus arranges for Mecha Butler No. 13 to take Hayate's place. Fully automated and machine-engineered to domestic perfection, this new cybernetic manservant boasts a wide variety of dazzling features and capabilities, from performing soothing backrubs to giving Nagi candid advice on her latest manga. Sie kämpfen mit allen Kräften, doch auf sie wartet ein bitteres Schicksal! Währenddessen wird Rokuro von einem Basara namens Shiromi aufgehalten. Zerschlägt Shiromi die gesamte Familie Enmado?

Die gleichzeitigen Fünferattacken der Basaras bringt die Onmyo-Vereinigung durcheinander. Auch das Oberhaupt der Familie, Rokuro Enmado, steckt mitten im Kampf und tritt gegen das Basara Shiromi an. Doch dann erscheint das zweitstärkste Basara Sakanashi in Magano und zeigt seine wahre Stärke ...

Der Bannkreis der Tsuchimikado-Insel verschwindet und die Unreinen können in die reale Welt eindringen. Rokuro und Arimori verlieren ihre Hoffnung, als sie sehen, dass Arima Tsuchimikado, das Oberhaupt der Onmyojis, von dem Basara Sakanashi besiegt wird. Doch Arima nutzt seine letzte Magiekraft, um sich zu retten und bricht das Tabu, um erneut gegen Sakanashi anzutreten.

Doch als sich Rokuro und Tenma an die Hand nehmen, wird die „Resonanz“ aktiviert und der Konterangriff startet!! Nun beginnt das Ende des tausendjährigen Kampfs zwischen den Onmyojis und den Unreinen … Mit welchem Schicksal muss Tenma leben, und welcher Albtraum überfällt Yuto …?

On the moon, a robot speaks with an Utrom as the Utroms build a base on the moon. On Earth, the turtles are fighting of the Madhattan Maulitia. The turtles decided to move up to the rooftops to avoid the Maulitia, but we're surprised to find them there with snowmobiles. After giving the Maulitia a beating, our heroes steal a few snowmoblies and head home. Michelangelo gets left behind and accidental gets hit by the bus he tries to flag down, but is helped by a mysterious figure. Donatello's snowmobile blows up due to poor maintenance and reveals a mysterious truck.

Elsewhere, Casey and April Jones, now married, head to the doctor to get information on their baby. In Northhampton, Shadow trains with Master Splinter and Metalhead while waiting to hear the results.

The Turtles are called into service when an act of terrorism threatens to spoil April O'Neil's nano surgery. The TMNT save April's life only to discover that Master Splinter has passed from this mortal coil.

Two young women are attacked by vampires in a park in broad daylight - one escapes, but the other is killed. Meanwhile, the Turtles prepare Master Splinter's funeral pyre and hold his farewell services.

April searches through old boxes in the attic, trying to discover any clues to her true past. Donatello is invited by the Utroms to join them on an investigation of the deadly dinosaurs. Raphael gets into hot water when he encounters a group of vampires.

Donatello and the Utroms investigate the jungle where the strange dinosaurs had attacked a previous exploration team and discover a bizarre new creature - brandishing a weapon! Meanwhile, April and Casey continue to delve into her mysterious past while Michelangelo begins his new career as an ambassador/tour guide for visiting aliens. Raphael suffers from complications after being attacked by vampires.

Renet visits April. Donatello and the Utroms refine their investigation. The Fugitoid works with scientists to try to determine what's happening to Raphael. Mikey continues his tour guide duties. Leo meets with Karai to discuss a new problem.
Mike takes the alien princess out for some Earth food. Raph gets loose and battles Fugitoid and Raptarr. Leonardo and Karai face one of the mysterious warriors. Donatello and the Utroms are captured.
Leonardo narrowly defeats the strange warrior in a pitched battle. Mike and the Regenta spend quality time together. Donatello and the Utroms find some allies in their strange prison. Raphael feeds.
Mikey and the Regenta clash. Leo and Karai interrogate the mysterious warrior. Raphael trades punches with Leatherhead. Donatello and his allies have visitors.

Glurin repairs the Fugitoid after his encounter with Raphael. Leonardo discovers a strange book that the Foot are mass producing. Raphael returns to the Turtles' lair and sees a vision of Master Splinter. Mike saves the Regenta's life. Don and his friends discover the identity of their weird captors.

A mysterious visitor arrives on Earth. Mike and Seri's relationship grows more complicated. Don discovers the nature of his captors. The Fugitoid meets with Raphael. Leonardo questions Karai about the diabolical book that the Foot Clan is distributing.

Michelangelo awakes in an ambulance and tries to escape - only to find that it's a flying ambulance! A winged super hero named Raptarr comes to his rescue and he's taken to a hospital where he meets an old friend. Don, Raph and Casey investigate the abandoned armored car. Meanwhile in Massachusetts, Shadow rides off on her dirt bike to escape Splinter's mothering and meets up with her boyfriend. More oddities occur on the moon...

The Regenta's bodyguards show up and it's not just another day at the beach for the princess (or Mikey). Don learns that things aren't exactly as he thought they were. Casey Jones dons his vigilante gear and runs into a female version of Nobody on the city streets. Leonardo returns to the sewer lair and discovers Raphael and the Fugitoid.
Mike awakens in unfamiliar territory. Leo and Raph reminisce. Donatello and his friends deal with the intelligent dinosaur problem. Casey questions April.
Renet takes April to the past to discover her origin. The first issue of TMNT without any Turtles.
Raph, Don and Leo begin a new project. Mikey faces hard realties in the alien prison. April prepares to go on a walkabout.
Casey and Raph ambush the vampires. Mike tries to contact Seri. Leonardo discovers mysterious papers amidst Splinter's things. Shadow follows her friend Jay and uncovers a menace.

Shadow is assaulted in the woods. Leonardo uses Splinter's old scrolls to travel. Azokk helps Mike make an escape attempt. The police question Count Yorga, one of the "vampires" that attacked Raphael.
Michelangelo escapes from prison only to run into a band of Triceraton commandos. Metalhead battles the Guardifriend. Leonardo arrives in the Battle Nexus.
Mike encounters his worst nightmare, and then wakes to find reality may not be any better. Don and Raph discover who's behind the attack on Shadow. Leonardo encounters trouble in the Battle Nexus.
People mysteriously disappear on city streets. Leonardo gets into hot water in the Battle Nexus while encountering an enigma. Mike gets a tour of a Triceraton spacecraft.

Casey, the Fugitoid and their Utrom friends run into trouble at the local watering hole. Leonardo makes friends and potential enemies in the Battle Nexus. Mikey learns more about his Triceraton benefactors.

In the jungles of Venezuela, a research team discovers a strange life form. Meanwhile, in the Big Apple, Casey, Raph and Don get the abandoned armored car running, much to the dismay of the local New Yorkers. Master Splinter and Shadow are enraptured by the television coverage of an invasion of Unidentified Flying Objects.

Casey awakens in a strange bed and finds himself face-to-face with Karai's "pet" hammerhead shark. Meanwhile, Michelangelo faces judgement before the Triceraton High Council as they prepare to go to war with the Styracodon empire.

We see the Triceratons battle in space, Donatello is trapped in an alternate reality fighting the Shredder as Robin Hood, April is seen running into trouble with some Hell's Angels and Master Splinter meets Gyogi who brings news about Leonardo's recent disappearance.

This is the last issue of Vol 4 of Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles and was not released in stores. Instead it was only published on Peter Laird's blog for free. The issue ends on a cliffhanger, however the conclusion has never come to surface.
Limited to 1,000 copies.

The Utroms finaly reveal themselves to the word in a very public display. Karai fantasises facing the turtles in battle while her aid keeps her updated on the news about the alien arrival. After watching the tv coverage of the Utroms Michelangelo and Raphael decide to get a closer look when the stumble on a mysterious robot in the sewers.

After the Mike and Raph instinctively attack the mysterious robot reveals himself the turtle's old friend Professor Honycutt (the Fugitoid) in a modified form.

Returning with him to the lair the watch the Utroms address to the UN stating that they have come in peace along with other species to share knowledge, culture and art. Pledging that after a year if human society wished them to, they would leave and not return for 100 years.

Jumping five months ahead visits by the general public are finaly allowed on the Utroms island base. April, Casey and Shadow meet up with the turtles who have spending most of their time there also learning the Foot Clan has won contract to act as security on the island.

As April passes through a scanner she sets off a security alarm and the group is attacked by a small army of Foot Soldiers.

The turtles, Casey and Shadow are all to eager to protect April from the attacking Foot Soldiers just like old times. After a while the Utroms break up the battle and clarify that they had detected nanobots within April's body.

Upon medical examination the Utroms identify the nanobots as ones they used during their first stay on Earth and stolen by Baxter Stockman. The turtles and Casey theorise that this is what Stockman injected her with during their previous encounter with him.

Meanwhile back in Northampton Shadow's boyfriend Jay uses the scope on his rifle to get a glimpse of Shadow's mysterious grandfather and shocked to see that he's a giant rat. He is then attacked by an angry Metalhead and Steve Steel.

Also contains the Gizmo story " A Few Small Repairs " by Michael Dooney

Donatello and Honycutt watch the Utrom Glurin as he is working on a transmat which he believes can move objects through dimensions and time. Unbeknownst to the pair Glurin is observing an alternate earth were the turtles are Super Heroes.

Returning to the Med lab the Utrom doctor has noted that the very act of being scanned has activated the nanobots and have begun attacking April's brain and central nervous system putting her into a coma.

Back in Northampton Jay tries convince Splinter, Metalhead and Steve Steel that he meant no harm.

Mr Braunze is brought to Northapton to use his mental abilities to ascertain if Jay can be trusted. Even though it is revealed that he was indeed telling the truth his mind is wiped of the entire event.

Back on Moon Island the turtles and Foot are practicing in the gymn when Leonardo's rival Cha Ocho challeges the turtle to a sparring match. The match becomes quite heated when Leonardo wins he angers Ocho who snaps his bokken. It looks like a fight between the Foot and the turtles is imminent until Karai arrives.

Further medical tests have concluded that April is not biologocaly related to her father and sister as her condition worsens.

Donatello visits the remains of Baxter Stockman which he has preserved and kept prisoner for years in secret, even to his brothers. After trying for hours to get the evil scientist to give him information on how to remove the nanobots from April's body he admits defeat and finaly puts his old enemy out of his misery.

Returning to Moon Island Glurin has come up with a way he thinks he can save April. Deciding to fight fire with fire he has made nanobots to combat the ones in April's body..though to the suprise of the turtles they've been customised to look familiar.

Attacking a Harbinger base, the H.A.R.D. Corps run up against the huge Eggbreaker, Big Boy. Fighting to the end, the H.A.R.D. Corps' own Maniac is slain by Big Boy! All this, just to steal a computer disc which is unknowingly rigged with a homing pulse that reveals the secret location of H.A.R.D. Corps headquarters. Still shocked by Maniac's death, the H.A.R.D. When Reiko was Takashi's age, she bound the names of demons and spirits in her Book of Friends, enslaving them to her capricious whim. Now Takashi is the owner of the book, and the creatures will do anything to get their names back.

Chapters 1 - 4.

One of Natsume’s elementary school classmates is in town, but the unexpected reunion is for a dark purpose. Shibata knows Natsume’s secret, and threatens to expose it if Natsume doesn’t do what he says!

Natsume and Tanuma are spending a rainy day helping Taki clean up a storehouse full of her grandfather's stuff. But old clothes and books aren't the only things sealed away. The friends accidentally release a very angry yokai. Is teamwork enough to stop the yokai from going on a rampage?!

Natsume meets a kindhearted yokai who has found a ruined letter he desperately needs to read. There is another yokai who has power over paper who might be able to help him. But this yokai’s name is sealed in the Book of Friends… Will it be willing to help the grandson of the woman who bound it?!

Intrigues abound in the world of professional exorcism, and Natsume wants nothing to do with it. But he has no choice when Matoba, head of a prominent exorcist clan, blackmails him into coming to an exorcist meeting. Is Natsume’s fate sealed when one of his special talents is exposed in front of Matoba?

Many of Natsume’s problems with the local yokai stem from his grandmother, Reiko. When she was his age, she went around challenging yokai, and when she won she sealed their names in her Book of Friends. But lately Natsume has been learning that Reiko was more than just a cruel conqueror. Will he ever know the full truth about his grandmother, and will yokai be the ones to help him discover it?

Natori summons Natsume to help him with an odd exorcism case. A retired exorcist can no longer see yokai, even the ones who are his servants, and strange things have started happening at his house. Are his bound yokai trying to kill him to release themselves from their contract?

Natsume's human friend Taki can only see yokai if they walk through one of her spell circles. Although many yokai see her spells as aggressive traps, putting her at risk of their retaliation, the latest yokai to pass through her circle may have something other than revenge in his heart. But is that any better...?

Can yokai and humans ever really be friends? Natsume meets a yokai who is trying to let go of his feelings for a human for both their sakes. But Natsume isn’t sure that kind of sacrifice is necessary. Can he help, or will his meddling only make their parting harder to bear?

A local exorcist has passed away, leaving behind a study packed with a lifetime of important yokai research. But his family are normal and don’t know where he’s hidden his workroom. Now all the exorcists in the area are on the hunt for the mysterious library. But Natsume can’t decide what is more dangerous—letting the other exorcists find the collection, or discovering it himself!

Contains Chapter 71 - 73 & Special Episode: A Fragment of a Dream.

Natsume isn’t looking forward to meeting with one of his old classmates, even though his new friend Tanuma is coming along for moral support. But brash Shibata has more on his mind than just reminiscing—a house on his street is being haunted by evil dolls! Can Natsume help, or will his presence just make a scary situation even worse?

Much to his surprise, Takashi is settling into his new home. He's even making friends at school. So when some of the other kids invite him to a test of courage at the old abandoned high school, he joins in despite his reservations. But the rumors about the old school being haunted are absolutely true, and the spirit that lives there has a special hatred for humans!

Chapter 5 - 8.

Even though Natsume is getting better at dealing with yokai, he still tries to stay uninvolved. But when he runs into a yokai with his head stuck in a jar, Natsume can’t leave him to suffer. But the yokai’s idea of a gift of gratitude turns Natsume into a little kid with no memories of his current life!

Nyanko Sensei hasn’t been home in days, and Natsume is starting to get worried. He knows Sensei left in a party mood, but he has no idea where his friend and bodyguard was headed. And now there are rumors of evil spirits from the east heading to the local forest. Will Natsume have to face this threat all on his own?

Natsume and his friends are visiting an old inn to see a yokai exhibition, but a sudden storm extends their visit into an overnight stay. All should be well, since the inn has a charmed door curtain that welcomes good spirits and keeps out evil. But tonight of all nights, they forget to put it out! Can Natsume and his friends protect the inn without endangering the friendly local yokai?!

Natsume and his friends stumble into a ghostly treasure hunt when they hear about a haunted painting. His friends are eager to investigate, but Natsume suspects it might involve a dangerous yokai. To protect his friends, Natsume goes along with the quest, but the strain of keeping them in the dark is starting to show. Will Natsume ever be able to tell them the truth?

Natsume wants to be happy for her when her brother suddenly returns home from college, but there’s something very odd about him. Is Taki’s family just weird, or should Natsume be worried for her safety?

Nyanko Sensei is missing, and the only clue to his whereabouts is a shard of pottery painted with calico markings! Following the urgings of a dream sent by the shard, Natsume travels to a local kiln and finds that there's far more going on than just a lost kitty yokai.

Chapter 100 - 102 & Special Episode.

The mystery of the missing Nyanko Sensei intensifies as Natsume and the prominent exorcists Natori and Matoba encounter a powerful, malevolent ceramic puppet with an appetite for clay kitties. Natsume and the exorcists must work together to bring it down, but how can Natsume team up with someone he doesn’t trust?

Takashi Natsume can see the spirits and demons that hide from the rest of humanity. He has always been set apart from other people because of his gift, drifting from relative to relative, never fitting in. Now he is a troubled high school student who has come to live in the small town where his grandmother grew up. And there he discovers that he has inherited more than just the Sight from the mysterious Reiko.

A beautiful white dragon has been shedding luminous scales in the skies over the neighborhood, but Natsume has never seen them land. When the mustachioed yokai Chobi breaks his beloved mother-of-pearl comb, Natsume decides one of the rare and lovely scales would make the perfect replacement! His quest to find one, however, ends up uncovering more than expected…

Since finding his grandmother’s book, Natsume has been hunted, haunted, and almost made into an hors d’oeuvre! He’s also met some really wonderful friends, both yokai and human. And now one of them desperately needs his help—but how can Natsume rescue Natori if the exorcist doesn’t even know who he is?!

Collects chapters 112-115, plus an Afterword.

When Natsume and his friend Tanuma help a young woman find her way through the woods, they end up having to take cover from a storm in a mysterious mansion! The shelter comes at a cost though, and the boys are cajoled into joining a séance to summon a yokai. But when a sudden power outage disrupts the ritual, Natsume, Tanuma, and Nyanko Sensei are faced with something far more strange than the errant yokai they were expecting!

Collects chapters 116-119, plus an Afterword

Takashi is busy returning the names his grandmother trapped in her book and helping the local yokai with their problems. But he has to put his good deeds on hold when a black Nyanko Sensei look-alike snatches the Book of Friends! Takashi and the real Nyanko trail the bad cat to a secret yokai meeting. Will they be in time to stop the impostor's wicked plans?!

Chapter 9 - 12.

Natsume receives a secondhand invitation to a gathering of antiques dealers and afficionados. The event, however, is no mundane auction, and the guest list is filled with friends and foes alike. When the whole building is locked down after a theft is discovered, Natsume must rally his allies before his enemies make their move!

A simple auction takes a turn for the sinister when the entire venue is locked down after several priceless items go missing. To make matters worse, the human guests aren’t the only ones stuck in the mansion! Now Natsume, his friends, and his questionable allies will need to solve the mystery of the thefts and uncover the secrets of the Nakatomi house if they ever want to get out.

Takashi's quiet afternoon in the forest is disrupted when an angry spirit tries to possess him. He manages to dodge the spiritual attack, but he can't as easily avoid the yokai's pleas for help. Now he's tracking down an escaped evil spirit that threatens the life of the forest. But he's still learning that yokai never tell the whole truth, and the secrets spirits keep spell trouble for him!

Chapter 13 - 15 & Special Episode 1 - 3.

Takashi thinks he's found a balance between yokai and friends when he goes with a group of classmates to a country inn for a marathon cram session before school starts again. But even the prosaic threat of homework can't keep the "other world" at bay, especially when the innkeeper has been dabbling in mermaid blood!

Chapters 16 - 19 & Special Episode 4.

Takashi rescues a young boy named Kai from an abandoned house, where he had been locked in a box. But this isn't just a case of bullying gone too far. Kai has been complaining about being chased by ghosts. Does he see yokai too, or is there something darker going on?

Chapters 20 - 22 & Special Episode 5 - 6.

Someone is attacking yokai and stealing their blood, and Takashi is dismayed to discover that the assailant is human! The more he investigates the attacks, the more danger he finds himself in as he digs deeper into the occult world of the exorcists. Someone is planning something horrible, and even the help of Natori--actor and exorcist extraordinaire--might not be enough to save the yokai…or Takashi!

Chapters 23 - 26 & Special Episode 7.

Nyanko Sensei is recovering after being wounded in the last yokai incident, so Takashi is on his own when he accidentally releases a yokai right before the school festival. With new friends and his ever-strengthening relationship with the Fujiwaras, Takashi has more reasons than ever to keep the supernatural at bay. But does he stand a chance without Nyanko Sensei's power to back him up?

Natsume learns that no good deed goes unpunished when an irate yokai accuses him of stealing her ring when she came to the Fujiwara house to get her name returned. Natsume thinks he knows where the ring has disappeared to, but can he find it in time, or will the place he’s come to think of as home be destroyed by the vengeful yokai?!

But when the most popular boy in class befriends her, she's sure to make more than just that--she's about to make some enemies too!

description: Kurumi's got it all--looks, popularity and friends. But underneath Kurumi's friendly exterior is a manipulative girl who'll do anything to get what she wants! And she wants Kazehaya! Will Kurumi's plotting drive Kazehaya and Sawako apart, or will it instead draw them even closer together?

series_title: Kimi ni Todoke: From Me to You
description: Sawako finally realizes that her feelings for Kazehaya are more than just admiration. But this novice in love has a lot to learn about romance. Not that Chizu can help her out any--she's got enough worries of her own to deal with! Can either of these shy girls take the next step toward a real relationship?

series_title: Kimi ni Todoke: From Me to You
description: Chizu is surprised by the sudden homecoming of Toru, Ryu's older brother and her childhood crush. But old habits die hard when Chizu can't seem to get enough courage to declare her love. But this is the one time Chizu won't be able to count on Ryu to be supportive of her--not when he wants her for himself!

series_title: Kimi ni Todoke: From Me to You
description: After an eventful Christmas with her classmates, Sawako is super excited when Chizu and Ayane invite her to come with them to the shrine on New Year's Eve, which happens to be her birthday. But what she doesn't count on is her friends' birthday surprise--to get her to go alone with Kazehaya-kun!

series_title: Kimi ni Todoke: From Me to You
description: A new school year begins happily when Sawako and her friends Chizu and Ayane--as well as her crush, Kazehaya--are all in the same homeroom. But when another popular guy in the class shows an interest in Sawako, will it push Kazehaya and Sawako apart?

series_title: Kimi ni Todoke: From Me to You
description: Kento, a new classmate, takes an interest in Kazehaya and Sawako's relationship, but his interference confuses Sawako even more. When Kazehaya tries to tell Sawako he has feelings for her, she completely misinterprets him. Will Sawako ever muster the confidence to confess her own feelings and resolve the misunderstanding?

Mafuyu is the no-nonsense, take-charge and hard-hitting leader of her high school gang. But when she gets expelled for being a delinquent, her mother, fed up with her daughter’s wayward ways, sends Mafuyu to an isolated school far off in the country.

Determined to make the best of the situation and make her mother proud, Mafuyu decides to turn over a new, feminine, well-behaved leaf. But her fighting spirit can’t be kept down, and the night before school starts she finds herself defending some guy who’s getting beaten up. One slip wouldn’t have been a problem, except the guy is…her teacher?! How can Mafuyu learn to be a good girl if her teacher won’t let her forget her wicked past?

Yui might be a spy for the Student Council, but he still takes his duties as a member of the Public Morals Club very seriously! When he notices that the club has been a little stagnant lately, he decides to liven things up with some ninja training. But while he’s whipping Mafuyu and Hayasaka into shape, forces on the Student Council are working against him…

Hayasaka has been gloomier than usual since he hasn’t been able to see Super Bun in a long time. Shinobu butts his ninja nose in and suggests Hayasaka and Super Bun go on date for Christmas Eve. Mafuyu very reluctantly agrees to play “matchmaker,” and dons the rabbit mask to help cheer up her friend. But the date goes much better than she expected! How is she going to deal with Hayasaka now?

Can she clean up her act and still kick some butt?

Mafuyu is the no-nonsense, take-charge and hard-hitting leader of her high school gang. But when she gets expelled for being a delinquent, her mother, fed up with her daughter’s wayward ways, sends Mafuyu to an isolated school far off in the country.

After her stunning defeat at the hands of Ayabe from the Student Council, Mafuyu is determined to know her enemy. But instead of getting the inside scoop on how to bring him down, Mafuyu finds herself making a new friend. When it becomes clear that her new friend has family issues, Mafuyu vows to help him out…even if it takes extreme force!

So far every Student Council member who has gone up against Mafuyu and the Public Morals Club has fallen to the team's superior friendship skills. But Kanon Nonoguchi has a plan to turn their strengths against them! She's spreading rumors that Midorigaoka girls are in danger and counting on Super Bun to run to the rescue...and right into her trap!

Kanon Nonoguchi, enemy to the Public Morals Club, has been kidnapped by the Kiyama High delinquents! So of course Mafuyu and her club mates set off at once to rescue their nemesis. But even if Mafuyu and the others can help Kanon break out of the Kiyama storage shed, will she be able to escape her painful past?

Chapter 76 - 81.

Mafuyu is really happy to be a normal student going on a normal school trip. In her delinquent past, school trips were all about beating up on hooligans from other schools, so she’s excited at the chance to relax and enjoy the activities. But it turns out her old rivals from West High are in the same town on their school trip! Will Sakurada ruin her cherished taste of normalcy?!

After returning from the school trip, Mafuyu and the rest of the Public Morals Club learn all about Akki’s adventure with Komari. The story makes Mafuyu realize that all the attacks from the Student Council so far have been solo affairs. Why haven’t they teamed up to take down the Public Morals Club? Determined to get to the bottom of this mystery, Mafuyu sneaks into Hanabusa’s lair…the Student Council Room!

Someone has been blackmailing members of the Public Morals Club into resigning! Mafuyu and Hayasaka have figured out what got Akki and Okegawa to quit, but Yui rejoined the student council and they haven’t seen him for days. Worried about their friend, they break into his room to find him. But Yui’s defection wasn’t coerced—and he’s more determined than ever to protect Miyabi’s interests! Will this be the end to more that just their friendship?!

It’s summertime, and the students of Midorigaoka Academy are indulging in the time-honored tradition of a test of courage! A walk through a “haunted woods,” it beats the heat by chilling the blood and forms bonds of friendship through shared terror. It’s the perfect activity for Mafuyu! But not everyone joining the fun has pure-hearted revelry in mind—some mysterious villains are using the test of courage as a cover to attack the Public Morals Club!

Hayasaka is losing his memories! It’s a stressful situation, but he doesn’t really remember his friends in the Public Morals Club, so he doesn’t have anyone to turn to for help. When he gets suspended for fighting, he decides there’s no reason to go back to Midorigaoka. But Mafuyu and Yui aren’t going to give up on their friend, even if they have to travel deep into the mountains to a house full of dark secrets to find him!

Mafuyu's plan to be an ordinary student seems to be working out so far. She's got a friend (Hayasaka) and a plan to join a totally normal school club (crafts). But homeroom teacher Mr. Takaomi has something different in mind--he wants Mafuyu to take down the notorious leader of the campus gang!

After the burden of his past sent Hayasaka fleeing into the stormy night, his dad is finally ready to reveal their family secrets. But is Hayasaka ready to remember why his memories started to disappear in the first place?!

Mafuyu has a typically bizarre visit to her hometown over winter break, but even that weirdness isn’t enough to prepare her for what’s going on back at Midorigaoka Academy—someone is impersonating Super Bun to do evil deeds! Can the Public Morals club unmask the creepy doppelganger before Super Bun’s reputation is permanently destroyed?!

Someone mysterious is pretending to be Super Bun and harassing the members of the student council! Mafuyu and friends almost capture the impostor, but she manages to give them the slip. Then a chance conversation with Okegawa gives Mafuyu just the clue she needs. Has she finally worked out the identity of the fraudulent Bun?!

It’s Mafuyu’s last year of high school! With Miyabi and most of the delinquents safely graduated, Mafuyu and her friends are looking forward to a peaceful final year. But a mysterious new first-year is up to something sinister, and her schemes quickly take Mr. Saeki out of the picture. Now the fate of the whole school rests on the shoulders of the suddenly advisorless Public Morals Club!

Mafuyu and the Public Morals Club are trying to investigate the Beast of Kiyama High, but his super strength and advanced disguise skills have them flummoxed. Even Shinobu’s feats of nighttime ninja prowess only serve to get him captured by the Beast. And back on home turf, Mafuyu finds herself inexplicably spending more time with their weird new homeroom teacher. He’s a mystery waiting to be cracked, but will the accidents that dog his footsteps crack her first?

Mr. Maki, the new homeroom teacher, keeps getting weirder. To try to get to the bottom of their mystery teacher, Mafuyu and her friends are using the summer break to do some investigating. The search turns up something unexpected—Mafuyu realizes that she has almost no memories from when she was in elementary school. Was her life really that boring, or is her brain suppressing something truly shocking?

Mafuyu’s homeroom teacher Mr. Maki isn't just a conundrum, he's also a kidnapper! Right when Mafuyu thought she was getting to the bottom of her missing memories, Mr. Maki spirited her away to an amazing mansion. While Mafuyu is a sucker for mansions, she does have a school to save. But she can’t escape on her own, and all her friends think she’s just home with a cold. Now her only choice is to rely on her enemy!

It’s time for the Midorigaoka school festival, and rumors abound that Mr. Maki has some trouble planned. Mafuyu escapes from the Hanabusa mansion and heads to campus in her Natsuo disguise, while Takaomi welcomes a posse of Midorigaoka alumni and some of Mafuyu’s delinquents from Saitama. With the troops all assembled, the only thing left to do is wait for Mr. Maki to make his move…

Mr. Maki’s hired goons have taken over the auditorium! With the stage inaccessible due to the massed delinquents, the school play has to be canceled for “technical difficulties.” But disaster is averted by quick thinking and teamwork as the disappointed audience is sent to view the other marvels of the festival. Now all Mafuyu and her friends need to do is take down the huge crowd of invading bruisers! The fight for Midorigaoka is on!

Note: The digital edition (3/2/2021) for this volume was released before the print edition.

Mafuyu and her friends manage to save the school festival at the last minute, and with it the future of Midorigaoka Academy! But when Takaomi rushes to the hospital to tell his grandfather, all he finds is an empty bed. Has victory come too late?!

Mafuyu is heading home for the weekend to get some much-needed TLC. But neither her mom nor her hometown seem to be in the mood for a warm welcome. Trying to walk off the weird feelings, Mafuyu and some of her old East High comrades are caught in a trap set by the gang from West High! Can she help her former friends without compromising her fresh start?

Troublemaking student council chairman Hanabusa thinks the best way to solve the problem of two similar clubs at school is to have them fight to the death! Actually, the losers just have to disband their club. But a silly club rivalry quickly gets out of hand when Mafuyu is kidnapped by the enemy!

Mafuyu is looking forward to a relaxing day at the beach after all the recent commotion at school. But with Takaomi tagging along she should have known better than to expect calm and quiet. He plays rescuer to a couple getting harassed by delinquents and of course makes everything worse. Now Mafuyu has to save her vacation and her teacher!

The student council's very own ninja, Shinobu Yui, is set on destroying Mafuyu's club. He thinks he can take it down by taking on Mafuyu, but he didn't count on the power of her alter ego, Super Bun! Besides, Mafuyu really has better things to do with her time, like attempting to be a regular high schooler and beating the secrets out of her teacher, Mr. Saeki.

Mafuyu finally discovers the truth behind Takaomi’s bizarre bet with the principal of Midorigaoka Academy! The twisted tale elicits her sympathy, and she decides to put her all into helping him out. But her all may be less than she hopes as she faces down the looming threat of...finals!

Summer break doesn't mean rest and relaxation for Mafuyu. She has a ton of homework to finish, but finds herself distracted when a drunken colleague shows up at Takaomi's apartment. It's up to Mafuyu to convince the guy that Takaomi is a good teacher, but will he take the word of an obvious delinquent?!

The yearly culture festival is coming up fast, and it’s a great chance for Midorigaoka Academy to shine. But disappearing students and rising tensions between the academy and nearby Kiyama High could turn the festival into a full-on disaster! Can a pack of delinquents save the day and the school?

description: Out of the ashes of misfortune will rise the next generation of great adventurers! Can the New Brighton kids stop Galomar before he opens the doorway between a dangerous world of lost magic and our own? Will they be able to save Cooper before it's too late? And what secrets does Red hold? The New Brighton Archeological Society takes to the skies, the seas, and land as they discover magical worlds in this spellbinding, larger than life adventure!

Aircel's comic adaptation of Carmilla is loosely based on J. Sheridan Le Fanu's 1872 novella. The first book in the volume is the most true to Le Fanu's original plot. Arguably the Ur-mother of the lesbian vampire, Carmilla is portrayed as a predatory and devious figure that feigns vulnerability to infiltrate the home of the young protagonist Sarah (originally named Laura in the novella).

The story begins with Carmilla paying a late night visit to Sarah as a young girl, which she then attributes to a dream despite the evidence of a vampire bite. The interlude then unapologetically shows a sapphic sex-scene with Carmilla/Millarca and another woman. Following the interlude, the narrative returns to Le Fanu's original plot with the news that Mademoiselle Rheinfeldt, who was due to pay the protagonist a visit with her guardian, has been killed by a "monster." Sarah's vows to search for this monster are then interrupted by a carriage accident, in which a mysterious young woman is supposedly injured. Sarah then convinces her father Tobias to take in the seemingly vulnerable young lady so she may recover.

Following a visit from the doctor, Sarah requests that she be allowed to see the young lady. The protagonist then recognises the mysterious house guest as the figure from her 'dream' all those years ago. Before she can reveal this, however, Carmilla cunningly appropriates the details of the encounter and deceives Sarah into believing she shared the same 'dream.' Having gained the protagonist's trust through these falsified claims, Carmilla attempts to get closer to her and a close bond begins to develop between the pair. The issue then ends with a voyeuristic scene, in which the vampire watches the young woman undress through the window. It is then ambiguously implied that the vampiric exchange that follows may also be a sexual one. Whilst the lesbian undertones are certainly present in Le Fanu's novella, the Aircel adaptation unapologetically and explicitly portrays the vampire's homosexuality.

description: When cartoonist Joe Matt unexpectedly passed away in 2023 at the age of sixty, it appeared that any hope of seeing new work from the master cartoonist would die with him. Matt, notoriously slow, had been working on a new issue for 17 years – since the previous issue was published in 2006. After his death, it was discovered that the entire issue was complete aside from four uninked pages. Thanks to Matt’s cartoonist friends, Peepshow #15 will finally see print, and it’s an event worthy of celebration. The issue is quintessential Matt, as if he had never left us: utterly shameless, completely self-absorbed, crafted with an exhibitionist's enthusiasm for his favorite subject, himself. Detailing his move to Los Angeles in 2003—"trapped in a world he never made!”—to pursue an ill-fated HBO series. Peepshow #15 is Joe Matt at his Joe Mattiest.
